moves.comment: Take space in the centre and open the diagonals of your queen and f1 bishop. This starts your 1.e4 repertoire, alongside the London.

children.comment: Develop your queen-side knight. It defends e4 and controls d5. Keep the f-pawn free for the gambit.
Challenge the e5 pawn with your f-pawn. This weakens your king-side diagonals too: develop promptly and watch the central counterstrike.
Take the e5 pawn. Black has struck at the centre, so answer that tension before starting a king-side attack; develop the g1 knight next when possible.
Bring your knight to f3. From f3 it controls d4 and e5. Keep watching Black's replies before advancing more pawns.
